explication: OpenHuman is an agent harness with a desktop interface and a Rust library/runtime. The main user journey is to submit a request through the app or another host, have the runtime execute agent work, and receive a result; the repository also exposes workflows, memory, integrations, and fleet-oriented developer interfaces. The source excerpts show selected memory and storage bindings, while the README documents broader capabilities such as tool search, token compression, and loadable modules. Unshown runtime wiring is omitted or marked unverified.
